_readme: Round v5 (consistent teacher). Session 1: SFT v5 seed 1 -> heldout dev evals -> GATE: continue only if SFT v5 + constraint beats SFT v3's 79.5% on heldout; otherwise both queues stop and we change course. Then GRPO v5 seed 1 (GPU 0) and SFT v5 seed 2 (GPU 1). Review session 1 before session 2: run GRPO seeds only if GRPO s1 beats SFT s1 on the select split (best val in metrics.jsonl); else replace them by SFT seed 3 only. Final test: set FINAL_RUN to the run chosen by the select split, run once. Launch: python kaggle/job.py plan kaggle/plans/v5.json session1 UPDATE after the gate: word-level decoding (--constrain-mode word) replaced the token-greedy constraint, so the gate threshold no longer applies. 'final-and-grpo' = the declared one-time final test of sft-gemma270m-v5-s1 (both settings) + GRPO v5 s1; 'seeds' = SFT v5 seeds 2 and 3, no gate.
